title: Story premise ENT049: The Kite That Rebuilt the Skyline
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: The skyline is packed flat. The kite is clocking in. Takeaway/theme: The order of assembly can be part of the spectacle.
description: A cubic festival organizer must raise a skyline-shaped banner, but the folded display lies in a heap. A tethered fantasy kite pulls a guided cable through successive counterweighted facades, raising each panel to its stop until their shadows spell the festival’s invented name.
